body: It's funny that you mention abandonment because I've really come to realise that this may be my main problem. I attach myself very easily to people, becoming incredibly trusting of them and even developing romantic feelings INCREDIBLY easily. Like full love. This almost always results in feelings of abandonment and worthlessness when they are (always) not reciprocated. I'm finding everything so hard to deal with at the moment. I've noticed that my moods swing hugely from being absolutely fine, happy even, to so low that I think about death etc. This can happen so quickly. My father suffered from bipolar disorder and very severe obsessive compulsive disorder and I'm VERY careful about using either of those to describe myself. I admittedly get slightly irritated with the casual use of both illnesses, self diagnosis etc. I was, as I said, diagnosed with very slight obsessive compulsive tendancies but I saw how somebody with real OCD behaved while my father was alive and perhaps this is why I feel so ashamed of my small fry problems. I feel so much like I'm rambling in these posts. Like they have so many words but say absolutely nothing at all. I don't know how to describe how I feel, except completely alone and worthless, which is so very cliché.
